Basic Information.Supported CPU: Support the 14th/13th and 12th generation Intel adapting to the LGA 1700 slot of the motherboard Core TM, Pentium And Cylon processor

Memory.Supported Memory:
- DDR5-6800 (OC)/6600 (OC)/6400 (OC)/6200 (OC)/6000 (OC)/5800 (OC)/5600 (OC)/5400 (OC)/5200 (OC)/5000 (OC)/4800MHz memory
- Intel is supported  Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) memory technology
- supports dual channel memory technology
Memory.Maximum Memory: up to 192 GB of memory (a single socket can support up to 48 GB of memory)

Graphics.Graphics:
Integrated Graphics Processor-Intel HD Graphics support:
1 x HDMI 2.0 interface, Up to 4K 60Hz resolution
1 x DP 1.2 interface, supporting up to 4K 60Hz resolution

Connector & Ports.Supported Storage:
A total of 3 M.2 slots and 4 SATA 6Gb/s hard disk interfaces are supported,
- M.2_ 1 slot: support 2242/2280 M.2 SSD (PCIe 4.0 x4, CPU channel)
- M.2_ 2 slots: support 2242/2260/2280 M.2 SSD (PCIe 4.0 x4, PCH channel)
- M.2_ 3 slots: support 2242/2260/2280 M.2 SSD (PCIe 4.0 x4, PCH channel)
Connector & Ports.RAID: Support the creation of RAID 0, RAID 1, RAID 5, and RAID 10 disk arrays using SATA hard disk devices
Connector & Ports.Internal I/O Ports:
Rear I/O interface:
- 4 USB 2.0 interfaces
- 2 USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A interfaces
- 1 USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C interface
- 1 DP 1.2 interface, supporting up to 4K 60Hz resolution
- 1 HDMI 2.0 interface, Up to 4K 60Hz resolution
- 1 2.5G network interface
- 3 audio interfaces (audio input/audio output/microphone)
Onboard device interface:
- 1 CPU fan pin
- 3 system fan pins
- 1 water-cooled pump pin
- 1 USB 2.0 pin can expand 2 USB 2.0 Type-A interfaces
- 1 USB 3.2 Gen 1 pin can expand 2 USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A interfaces
- 1 USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C slot can expand 1 USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C interface
- 2 5V 3-pin ARGB pins
- 2 12V 4-pin RGB pins
- 1 Front audio pin
- 1 Front panel pin
- 1 speaker pin
- 1 clear CMOS jumper
- 1 serial port pin
- 1 BIOS burner pin
- 1 diagnostic card pin
- 1 ME write protection jumper
- 1 RGB lamp efficiency control jumper
